OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

SPUR_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to the objects created by the connector.

SPUR_DEFAULT_SCORE.description: Base OpenCTI score of an IP that Spur flags with offensive risks (AD_FRAUD, CALLBACK_PROXY, LOGIN_BRUTEFORCE, WEB_SCRAPING). The final score is `default_score + 5 x number of offensive risks`, capped at 100. An IP without offensive risk keeps its current score.

SPUR_FETCH_TAG_METADATA.description: Fetch the Spur metadata of the services seen on the IP (tunnel operators, client proxies, AI operators) to describe their infrastructures: categories, protocols, no-log policy, metrics... Each distinct service costs one more query of the Context API quota, cached for 24 hours.
